original: "Whoever paid me. Then the men who'd have to keep it fed after I'd gone home." I nodded up at the tank on its legs. "That fills itself out of a stream and a bit of weather. What I'd put in her would want a man's whole attention, and it would want it every day, and the first day it went without, you'd be standing here just the same. Only later, and further from a town."
revised: "Whoever paid me. Then the men who'd have to keep it in order after I'd gone home." I nodded up at the tank on its legs. "That fills itself out of a stream and a bit of weather. What I'd put in her would want a man's whole attention, and it would want it every day, and the first day it went without, you'd be standing here just the same. Only later, and further from a town."
